## Changes

- Add opt-in temporary conversations that stay out of history, with a default setting and a per-conversation switch before the first message (thanks @laolxun, #104).
- Show the conversation title and regular or temporary status in a compact header above the chat.
- Let /btw side chats inherit the parent conversation's settings and handle edit requests using normal permissions and approvals.
- Stop interrupting side-chat work when its panel closes; use Interrupt to stop a running turn explicitly.
- Wait for thread-setting changes to take effect before sending the next turn, and correctly restore configured model, reasoning effort, and permission settings.
